LoginHero.title: Billing that keeps up with your business.
LoginHero.subtitle: Invoices, purchases, inventory and GST — all in one place, built for Indian retail and distribution.
LoginHero.feature1Description: Invoices, bills, credit and debit notes with automatic tax breakdowns.
LoginHero.feature2Description: Track stock across locations with a full, append-only movement history.
LoginHero.feature3Description: Bring your whole team in with owner, admin and member roles.

LoginForm.title: Login to your account
LoginForm.subtitle: Enter your email below to login to your account
LoginForm.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
LoginForm.networkError: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
LoginForm.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

Common.loadError: Something went wrong loading this page.
Common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

RecordPayment.title: Record Payment
RecordPayment.description: Record a payment received against this document.

BillingPos.title: Billing
BillingPos.description: Quick point-of-sale billing — each tab is a draft invoice.
BillingPos.emptyCart: Cart is empty. Click an item to add it.
BillingPos.outOfStockNote: Stock-tracked items will be sold from the warehouse set on this draft invoice.
BillingPos.selectWarehouseFirst: Select a warehouse to start selling from it.

Invoices.title: Invoices
Invoices.description: All sales invoices for your organization.
Invoices.variantPlaceholder: Select which purchase to sell from…
Invoices.variantNoneAvailable: No purchases recorded yet for this item
Invoices.voidConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone — the invoice becomes permanently void. Create a new invoice if you need to reissue it.

CreditNotes.title: Credit Notes
CreditNotes.invoicePlaceholder: Select the invoice being returned against…
CreditNotes.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Damaged goods, wrong item shipped…
CreditNotes.returnItemsDescription: Pulled from the original invoice — quantity can't exceed what's still unreturned.
CreditNotes.noReturnableItems: Every line on this invoice has already been fully returned.
CreditNotes.restockingNote: Issuing this credit note automatically returns these quantities to stock.
CreditNotes.voidConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone — the credit note becomes permanently void and its restock is reversed.

PurchaseBills.title: Purchase Bills
PurchaseBills.noDiscountNote: Purchase bills have no discount field — GST rules apply discounts at the vendor's invoice level, not here.
PurchaseBills.sellingPriceHint: For stock-tracked items, this becomes the price this specific purchase sells at.
PurchaseBills.voidConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone — the bill becomes permanently void. Create a new bill if you need to reissue it.

DebitNotes.title: Debit Notes
DebitNotes.billPlaceholder: Select the bill being returned against…
DebitNotes.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Damaged goods, wrong item received…
DebitNotes.returnItemsDescription: Pulled from the original bill — quantity can't exceed what's still unreturned.
DebitNotes.noReturnableItems: Every line on this bill has already been fully returned.
DebitNotes.destockingNote: Issuing this debit note automatically removes these quantities from stock.
DebitNotes.voidConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone — the debit note becomes permanently void and its destock is reversed.

Stock.title: Stock
Stock.description: Current quantity on hand, by item and warehouse.
Stock.noResults: No stock yet — record a purchase or an adjustment to get started.

StockMovements.title: Stock Movements
StockMovements.description: Append-only ledger — every change in either direction.
StockMovements.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Manual stock count correction, damaged goods write-off…
StockMovements.adjustmentOnlyNote: This is the only stock movement you can create directly. Purchase, sale and return movements are written automatically when a document's status changes.

SettingsOrganization.title: Organization
SettingsOrganization.description: GST, document numbering and appearance settings.
SettingsOrganization.gstDescription: Tax registration used on all documents.
SettingsOrganization.gstRegisteredHint: Show tax breakdowns and GSTIN on documents.
SettingsOrganization.pdfDescription: Branding shown on invoice and bill PDFs.
SettingsOrganization.watermarkHint: Shown across draft/copy PDFs. Leave blank for none.
SettingsOrganization.lowStockAlertsHint: Notify when an item drops below its reorder level.
SettingsOrganization.accountStatusDescription: Set only by a superadmin — not editable here.

SettingsMembers.title: Members
SettingsMembers.description: People with access to this organization.
SettingsMembers.removeConfirmDescription: They'll immediately lose access to this organization.
SettingsMembers.inviteNotWiredUp: Inviting new members isn't wired up yet — that needs a real email-invite flow (send a link, create their account on acceptance, then add the membership). For now, a superadmin can add a membership directly.

AppSettingsPage.title: App Settings
AppSettingsPage.description: Personal preferences — these apply only to your account, not the organization.
AppSettingsPage.appearanceDescription: Theme, color preset and language for this device.

SubscriptionAlert.expiredDescriptionCancelled: Your organization's subscription was cancelled. Your team has lost access to invoices, purchases, inventory and every other org feature until it's reactivated.
SubscriptionAlert.expiredDescriptionPastDue: Your organization's subscription payment is past due. Your team has lost access to invoices, purchases, inventory and every other org feature until it's brought current.
SubscriptionAlert.expiredDescriptionInactive: Your organization has been deactivated by a platform administrator. Your team has lost access until it's reactivated.
SubscriptionAlert.expiringDescription: Your organization's current billing period ends on {date}. Renew before then to avoid losing access to invoices, purchases, inventory and every other org feature.
SubscriptionAlert.contactNote: No payment gateway is wired up yet — contact a platform administrator to resolve this.

Subscription.title: My Subscription
Subscription.included1: Unlimited invoices, bills, credit & debit notes
Subscription.included2: Multi-warehouse inventory with append-only stock ledger
Subscription.included3: Named discount offers with date-window enforcement
Subscription.noPaymentGatewayNote: No payment gateway is wired up yet — subscription status is currently set by a superadmin.

Addons.title: Add-ons
Addons.description: Optional features you can add to your base plan.
Addons.superadminOnlyNote: Add-ons renew on your base plan's billing cycle. Subscribing or cancelling here calls the same superadmin-only functions the schema defines — visible to you, but only a superadmin's click actually takes effect.
Addons.notSuperadminNote: You're viewing what's included — subscribing or cancelling an add-on is a superadmin action.
Addons.cancelConfirmDescription: This takes effect immediately for your organization.

AdminOrganizations.title: Organizations
AdminOrganizations.createDescription: New organizations start on a trialing subscription.
AdminOrganizations.statusDescription: Superadmin-only controls — these gate access to every table in the org.
AdminOrganizations.activeHint: Turning this off immediately locks out every member of this organization.
AdminOrganizations.teamDescription: Create the first user so they can log in and set up their store.
AdminOrganizations.addUserDialogDescription: Creates a real login for this organization with a temporary password.
AdminOrganizations.userCreatedDescription: Share these credentials with them directly — this password is shown only once and can't be retrieved again.

AdminSuperadmins.title: Superadmins
AdminSuperadmins.description: Users with unrestricted, cross-organization platform access.
AdminSuperadmins.noAddUiNote: Granting superadmin access has no UI on purpose — it's a manual database step, not something the app should expose.

PartyFields.notesPlaceholder: Internal notes, not shown to the party…

Customers.title: Customers
Customers.basicDetailsDescription: Who this customer is, and how to reach them.
Customers.addressDescription: Used on invoice and credit note PDFs.
Customers.deleteDescription: This customer's past invoices are kept, but they'll no longer be selectable on new ones.

Items.title: Items
Items.pricingDescription: Prefills new invoice and bill line items — editable per document.
Items.pricingDescriptionTracked: Stock-tracked items carry no price of their own — cost and selling price are set together each time you record a purchase.
Items.purchasePriceHintTracked: Just a starting estimate for your next purchase — the real cost is entered on the purchase bill.
Items.trackInventoryHint: Deducts stock on sale, restores on return. Turn off for services.
Items.activeHint: Inactive items are hidden from new documents but keep their history.
Items.deleteDescription: This item's history on past documents is kept, but it'll no longer be selectable on new ones.

Offers.title: Offers
Offers.scopeDescription: Offers outside their date window are ignored automatically.
Offers.saveFirstNote: Save this offer first, then come back here to choose specific items.
Offers.activeHint: Inactive offers can't be attached to new documents.
Offers.noItemsToPick: No items in your catalog yet.
Offers.deleteDescription: Invoices that already used this offer keep their applied discount — this only removes it from future use.

TaxRates.title: Tax Rates
TaxRates.description: GST tax rates used across your catalog.
TaxRates.newDescription: Add a GST rate to use across your catalog.
TaxRates.defaultHint: Used to prefill new items unless overridden.
TaxRates.deleteDescription: Items using this tax rate keep their own rate — this only removes it from the picker.

Warehouses.title: Warehouses
Warehouses.newDescription: Add a stock location for your organization.
Warehouses.deleteDescription: Stock history tied to this warehouse is kept, but it'll no longer be selectable on new documents.

Vendors.title: Vendors
Vendors.basicDetailsDescription: Who this vendor is, and how to reach them.
Vendors.addressDescription: Used on purchase bill and debit note PDFs.
Vendors.deleteDescription: This vendor's past purchase bills are kept, but they'll no longer be selectable on new ones.

AuthCodeError.title: Sign-in link didn't work
AuthCodeError.description: That link is invalid or has expired. Go back and try signing in again.
